_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in the password. Any field can also be overridden by an env var: FVTT_BASE_URL, FVTT_WORLD, FVTT_USER, FVTT_PASSWORD, FVTT_ADMIN_KEY, FVTT_HEADLESS.
_server_comment: Auto-start (lib/server.js). launcher 'node' = headless server, 1 process / ~94 MB / no GPU renderer — the default, since the harness brings its own Chromium. launcher 'electron' = desktop GUI app, 5 processes / ~551 MB, for when a human wants a window. The node launcher REQUIRES dataPath; foundryMain is derived from foundryExe when blank.
foundryExe: C:\Program Files\Foundry Virtual Tabletop\Foundry Virtual Tabletop.exe
